en.heroTitle: Bulk Vermicompost Supplier — 50 kg Bags for Farmers & Dealers
en.heroLead: Satva Organics supplies premium vermicompost in 50 kg farmer bags and bulk quantities for apple orchards, polyhouse farms, nurseries, agri-input dealers, FPOs, and institutional buyers across North India.

sectionsBeforeTable.title: Who Bulk Vermicompost Is For
paragraphs: Bulk buyers need consistent quality, clean packaging, and reliable repeat supply—not just a low price per bag. Satva serves orchard owners, nursery operators, protected cultivation farms, agri retailers, cooperatives, and distributors who move 50 kg bags or tonnage regularly.
Our vermicompost is enriched with beneficial microbes and botanical extracts (neem, mustard cake) for stronger root-zone biology. Each batch is matured, screened, and packed for farm and dealer use.

sectionsBeforeTable.title: Quality Checklist Before You Buy in Bulk
paragraphs: When comparing suppliers, check maturity, moisture, smell, texture, and whether lab or batch documentation is available. Avoid wet, unfinished, or foul-smelling compost that can harm roots or attract pests.

faqs.question: What is the minimum order for 50 kg bags?
faqs.answer: We discuss minimum quantity based on your district and freight. Many farm and dealer orders start from a few bags; bulk tonne orders have separate MOQ. WhatsApp us with your location for a quick quote.

faqs.question: Do you supply outside Himachal, J&K, and UP?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our core markets are North India, and we also serve pan-India wholesale buyers through coordinated freight.

faqs.question: How do I know the compost is mature enough?
faqs.answer: Satva batches are cured and screened before packing. We can share quality documentation on request. See our quality & lab reports page for what we check on every lot.

हमारा वर्मीकम्पोस्ट लाभकारी सूक्ष्मजीवों और वनस्पति अर्क से समृद्ध है। हर बैच पका, छाना और पैक किया जाता है।
